title: Отличное приложение
body:
Отличное приложение, приятное оформление, не перегружено лишними функциями, только самое нужное! Очень помогает в формировании и поддержании привычек, в общем свои функции выполняет на все сто процентов!
Также хочу отметить очень быструю обратную связь, большое спасибо разработчику!
author: Dinara Otarova

title: Simple and Clean
body:
Easy to use, clean, and straightforward. Nothing extra, everything is clear, and the interface is very pleasant.

Feature requests:
- iCloud sync or automatic backups to avoid losing data
- Shortcuts actions: option to mark a habit as completed for a previous day

title: Awesome!
body:
As someone with ADHD living in a place where it’s not officially recognized or widely understood, staying organized has always been a major challenge. 
I’ve tried dozens of habit trackers and productivity apps, but HabitKit is the only one that truly clicked with how my brain works.

The app makes habit building feel fun rather than like a chore, which is exactly what I needed. I started with the free version and was amazed at how quickly I built solid daily habits. That felt like a huge win for me.

Eventually I upgraded to Pro and it made the experience even smoother and more customizable. It’s not just about tracking habits, it’s about building momentum and actually feeling proud of yourself every day. That’s a game changer when your motivation and focus can fluctuate so much.

Huge thanks to the creator for making such a thoughtful and powerful tool. HabitKit has genuinely improved my life and I’ve been recommending it to all my friends. Can’t recommend it enough, especially if you’ve struggled with consistency or executive dysfunction
